title: PRISM: Preference-based Reward and Uncertainty-Integrated Synthesis Minimization for RTL PPA Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.11051v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a budget-aware, multi-objective framework (called PRISM) for RTL optimization that improves power, performance, and area (PPA) while sharply limiting expensive commercial synthesis tool calls. Starting from a synthesizable baseline and functional testbench, the method iterates through LLM-driven rewrite generation, fast compile/simulation equivalence filtering, low-cost proxy feature extraction, and selective commercial synthesis tool (Synopsys Design Compiler (DC)) evaluation. To prioritize which candidates deserve high-quality synthesis, we train a preference-based reward model using pairwise ranking supervision derived from commercial synthesis tool outcomes, and combine ensemble uncertainty with a diversity-aware acquisition rule to avoid early bias and redundant evaluations. translated_title: PRISM：面向RTL PPA优化的基于偏好奖励与不确定性集成的综合最小化框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种预算感知的多目标框架（称为PRISM），用于RTL（寄存器传输级）优化，在大幅减少昂贵的商业综合工具调用的同时，提升功耗、性能和面积（PPA）指标。该方法从一个可综合的基线设计和功能测试平台出发，迭代执行以下流程：LLM驱动的代码重写生成、快速的编译/仿真等价性过滤、低成本的代理特征提取，以及选择性的商业综合工具评估。为了优先筛选出值得进行高质量综合的候选设计，我们利用从商业综合工具结果中获得的成对排序监督信号，训练了一个基于偏好的奖励模型，并将集成不确定性与多样性感知的采集规则相结合，以避免早期偏差和冗余评估。该方法的一个关键优势是，PRISM在整个运行过程中持续维护一个由非支配设计组成的最佳权衡集合G：G保留了最佳的……
tldr: PRISM是一个预算感知的多目标RTL优化框架，它通过基于偏好的奖励模型与不确定性引导的采集策略，在大幅减少昂贵商业综合工具调用次数的同时，有效优化设计的功耗、性能和面积（PPA）。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a budget-aware multi-objective RTL optimization framework that leverages a preference-based reward model and uncertainty-guided acquisition to improve power, performance, and area (PPA) while sharply reducing expensive commercial synthesis tool calls.
